summary: Iteration 5 — Frontend features FULLY VERIFIED. Backend regression BLOCKED by EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exceeded (litellm.BadRequestError: Max budget: 1.0, Current cost: 1.10). Only 4/9 backend tests pass — the 5 failing tests are ALL AI-call blocked (test_scan_pikachu, test_scan_non_card, test_scan_blurry_low_quality, test_voice_chat_with_context, test_voice_chat_empty_context) with identical 'Budget has been exceeded' upstream OpenAI/Gemini error surfacing as HTTP 502 from FastAPI (also seen as Cloudflare 502 on the public URL). NOT a code regression. FRONTEND (all iter-5 asks verified): (1) Floating yellow mic button REMOVED — 0 instances of mic-hold-btn in DOM. Top voice pill (data-testid=voice-pill-btn) is the sole voice trigger with press-in/press-out handlers. (2) Bottom info panel is flush to tab bar — cardPanel has borderBottomWidth:0 (index.tsx:588) and bottomWrap uses paddingBottom:insets.bottom (index.tsx:334). Visually confirmed via screenshot — 'Awaiting Card…' panel sits flush above the tab bar. (3) Settings screen is fully interactive AND persistent: SegRow for Auto-scan (0/3/5/10), Min confidence (40/55/70/85%), TTS voice (nova/alloy/echo/onyx/shimmer/sage/fable); SwitchRow for Haptics + Voice enabled; Show tutorial re-opens the tutorial modal. Selections update highlighted option and immediately persist to localStorage key 'app_settings_v1' (verified stored value: {"autoScanIntervalSec":0,"voiceEnabled":false,"ttsVoice":"alloy","confidenceThresholdPct":70,"hapticsEnabled":false}). Values survive page reload. (4) Scanner honors settings live via useSettings subscriber pattern: with Auto-scan set to OFF the auto-scan-indicator borderColor renders as rgb(46,46,46) (default border) instead of brand yellow; with Voice-enabled OFF the pill label reads 'VOICE OFF' and pill opacity is 0.5. First-boot tutorial gating still works (localStorage 'tutorial_seen'). Show-tutorial row from Settings correctly re-opens the tutorial modal. Backend price-accuracy code path was code-reviewed: server.py:_rank_candidate now weights number_match at 60 (line 234) vs 40 for name; fetch_price_and_meta returns strict flag (line 298); /api/scan-card returns price=null with an explanatory reasoning containing 'Exact set/number match not found' when non-strict (lines 425-442). Runtime validation of the price-accuracy path is blocked by the LLM budget.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:234 — number_match weight increased to 60 (was 30) correctly makes card number the dominant ranking signal, preventing set/name near-matches from returning wrong-printing prices.

server.py:277-290 — strict flag = number_match OR (no number read AND set_match). Sensible; if the vision model can't read the number the code falls back to set-hint matching rather than showing arbitrary prices.
server.py:406-442 — non-strict branch returns identified=true with price fields left null and a human-readable reasoning explaining what was found instead. Matches the iter-5 requirement.

settings.ts uses a module-level `current` + listeners Set so Scanner re-renders when Settings screen mutates — verified live: toggling voice-enabled in Settings then returning to Scanner immediately shows 'VOICE OFF' pill; toggling Auto-scan to 0 immediately removes the brand border on auto-scan-indicator.

settings.ts:23 loadSettings reads storage.getItem<string>(KEY,'') — the storage utility JSON-parses once, then loadSettings JSON.parses again. Works correctly because storage.setItem also JSON.stringifies once and the value the app writes is already a JSON string (double-encoded on disk). NOTE for future testers: pre-seeding localStorage from Playwright must double-stringify (JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(obj))) to match this format, otherwise the loader silently falls back to defaults.
index.tsx:271-297 voice pill Pressable uses onPressIn/onPressOut with disabled={!settings.voiceEnabled} — matches iter-5 requirement of press-and-hold; no floating mic anywhere in the tree.
index.tsx:334, 559-589 bottom panel geometry: bottomWrap positioned bottom:0 with paddingBottom:insets.bottom; cardPanel has borderBottomWidth:0. Flush against tab bar as required.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of 5 backend test failures: shared EMERGENT_LLM_KEY hit its $1.00 monthly/session budget cap (LiteLLM raises OpenAIException, wrapped by FastAPI as HTTPException 502). Reproduction: `curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/api/scan-card -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"image_base64":"<any-b64>"}'` returns `{"detail":"vision_error: ... Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 1.10, Max budget: 1.0"}`. Mitigation: main agent should escalate to raise the key's budget cap; no code change required.
